title: Spec Kit Plus Design Evidence v1
description: Formal Design Intelligence Evidence object. Prompt labels remain subordinate to this schema. Canonical types: measured | inferred | assumption. The prose alias evidence-backed-inference maps to inferred.

id.description: Optional stable id for cross-artifact references (for example EV-001).

claim.description: The design claim being asserted (token, layout rule, component observation, etc.).

type.description: Evidence level. Prefer measured | inferred | assumption. evidence-backed-inference is accepted as an inferred alias.

source.description: Inspectable origin: path, URL, screenshot id, live route, or export locator. Null only when source_gap explains the absence.

source_gap.description: Explicit gap statement when inferred claims lack a concrete source. Required when type is inferred/alias and source is empty.

rationale.description: Why the claim holds. Required for non-measured types after semantic validation.

subject.description: Optional subject key (for example color.primary or Button.default).
